_why: Complete original results up to 4 MiB qualify against the existing 48 MiB sampled Workerd heap-growth, 16 MiB database, and physical SQL ceilings. Accepted immutable-source retries use a compact owner receipt instead of re-decoding or returning the complete answer. The inline request limit remains unchanged; larger originals stay retained with an explicit refusal.
_prior_max_bytes_why: The previously shipped complete-result decoder bound; legacy unknown local size refusals need live fenced admission of bytes above this bound before one versioned retry.
